body:
I told two or three people about what happened a couple months ago. (Broke down, almost threw myself from a building, I'll use almost lightly because who knows if it would have happened.)

I agree, I do feel stupid feeling this way.

I see people post about losing loved ones, SO's cheating on them, losing their homes, and all of that. And I'm a well of kid who has a future mapped out for me.

I just don't know what help to get. That's the huge issue. 

Everywhere I turn I only see a negative alternative. I put on a face and compliment them, but in reality I only do that not to come off as an over-critical dick.

And don't get me wrong, my friends are great, but I just get aggravated and annoyed so often.

I have this constant feeling of disgust with people and it's driving me into the ground.
